splits.note: The day CShapes turns the code from colony to independent. The Republic is a record this atlas already had; it keeps only the features from this date on.

750.note: One CShapes code carries both the dependency and the independent state. Splitting it gives each its own actor, so a presence never hangs off a record whose dates do not contain it.

splits.note: The date CShapes itself gives the code as independent, not the 1949-12-27 the brief suggested: a split must fall on a boundary the source draws, and that day is not one. The nearest boundaries are 1945-08-17 and 1949-12-29.

850.note: As with 750: the dependency and the independent state under one code become two actors.
